description: A Scenario-Based Digital-Twin Assessment of Vision-Language Models for Building Energy Demand Forecasting and Automated Asset Intelligence is published by Palivela, Hemant; Arif Hasan, Afreen. It describes a replication package connecting rendered building images, EnergyPlus simulations and energy-demand forecasting. Coverage is national within US. Spatial resolution is not established here. The data period and sampling interval are not fully established. Access is through the public metadata page and its provider links. The metadata lists CSV, XLSX, Python, PDF; these files were not downloaded. Licence: Data and figures CC-BY-4.0; code MIT. The public page or repository can be read without payment; this does not establish free access to every linked artefact. The 250 building cases are simulated DOE archetypes across five ASHRAE climate zones. They are not measured buildings. This review identifies capacity planning, climate adaptation as potential simulation uses, subject to the stated limits. Related catalogue records are model-energyplus. These are contextual links; no unverified interoperability or actual use is claimed.
